title: Kuperin Belief
description: A proposition held or entertained by an entity within the story world.

holder.description: Character who holds or entertains the belief.

about.description: Stable IDs of entities or concepts this belief concerns.

state.description: Current relationship of the holder to the proposition.

confidence.description: Optional estimate of how strongly the holder believes the proposition.

supported_by.description: Stable IDs for events or evidence supporting the belief.

challenged_by.description: Stable IDs for events or evidence challenging the belief.

introduced_in.description: Source where this belief first became part of tracked state.
